1.3.2.1-r2.burton_quote: if there be more signs, and more evident in the head than elsewhere, the Brain is primarily affected, & prescribes head-melancholy to be cured by meats amongst the rest, void of wind, & good juice
1.3.2.1-r2.translation: the brain is seldom affected without the stomach

1.3.2.1-r3.burton_quote: for when the head is heated, it scorcheth the blood, and from thence proceed melancholy fumes, which trouble the mind
